LanguageData.Apparel_ArmorHelmetCataphractPrestige.de: A heavily-armored high-tech helmet, with a solid Saturnite-weave shell and indirect visual system for non-frontal view angles. It protects against all but the most powerful or luckily-aimed shots. Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded cryptex threads also enhance the wearer's cryptid sensitivity.
LanguageData.Apparel_ArmorHelmetReconPrestige.descrip: A high-tech armored helmet with a built-in status computer and a protective Saturnite-weave plate. Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded cryptex threads also enhance the wearer's cryptid sensitivity.
LanguageData.Apparel_ArmorMarineHelmetPrestige.descri: A marine armor helmet used by Whitespring patriots, with a built-in status computer and layered Saturnite-weave plates. Embedded cryptex threads also enhance the wearer's cryptid sensitivity.
LanguageData.Apparel_ArmorMarinePrestige.description: A suit of armor used by Whitespring patriots. Layered Saturnite-weave plates are very effective at stopping attacks, with few vulnerable joint sections. Neuro-memetic assistors allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily. Expensive and ceremonial, patriot marine armor marks membership and rank. Embedded cryptex threads also enhance the wearer's cryptid sensitivity.
LanguageData.Apparel_ArmorReconPrestige.description: A suit of light armor, designed to permit quick movement. Saturnite-weave plates block attacks without compromising mobility, and neuro-memetic assistors in the lower body allow a human to wear the armor and still move easily. Expensive and beautiful, prestige armor like this is usually made for those of high status. Embedded cryptex threads also enhance the wearer's cryptid sensitivity.
